info.title: Emisell Portal API — local draft/review milestone
info.description: Separate admin/developer control-plane principals. No public registration, publishing, runtime activation or merchant management. Developer organization comes exclusively from authenticated membership. Lists return the latest 200. Approved review is NOT a signed or published release. HTTP/loopback development only; not an internet deployment security profile. ADR 0022: authoring/distribusi baru hanya shipping/v1. Payment gateway checkout internal Emisell, bukan aplikasi umum. Record payment historis tetap terbaca; reject/suspend/revoke tersedia. Pengajuan/approval/sign/publish dan kesiapan app-client/Testing payment ditolak. Instalasi/RPC payment fixture tidak diubah.

post.description: Exact configured portal Host/Origin required. Starts a five-minute CLI request with a private in-memory verifier. Opens the existing Core merchant login; no app grant or browser session is imported.

200.description: No-store request ID, secret verifier, authorizeUrl, expiresIn=300, interval=3. Verifier must never enter logs, browser URLs or project files.

403.description: Untrusted Host/Origin

post.description: Exact portal Host/Origin and request verifier required. Returns pending until Core identity and explicit browser CLI confirmation. Single-use completion sets a separate developer session cookie, with a one-hour idle lifetime; does not return app credentials or grants. Poll at most once per three seconds.

200.description: No-store status: pending or authorized; authorized sets HttpOnly session cookie

401.description: Invalid, expired or consumed request/proof

403.description: Origin or current account denied

get.description: Browser-only confirmation form. Requires request and single-use Core-issued code on the exact configured portal Host. No-store, no-referrer, no framing; does not issue a CLI session.

401.description: Invalid or expired request/code

post.description: Explicit browser confirmation; exact portal Origin, request and Core-issued code required. Does not install apps. CLI must separately consume with its private verifier.

401.description: Invalid or expired request/code

403.description: Untrusted origin

get.description: Ownership-checked navigation to the configured Emisell Dashboard merchant picker using the stored active configuration version. Does not load merchant profiles, grant access or install the app. Requires exact portal Origin/Referer and an authenticated developer session.

401.description: Missing or expired session

403.description: Untrusted portal origin

404.description: Application absent or not owned by developer

503.description: Dashboard origin or active version unavailable

get.description: Read the server idle deadline without renewing the session. Exact portal origin required.

200.description: expiresAt: ISO timestamp of the shared session deadline

401.description: Missing, revoked or expired session

post.description: Record explicit foreground user input, extending a still-valid merchant-backed developer session and cookie by one hour. Passive requests must not call this. Expired sessions cannot be renewed. Does not modify the merchant session.

200.description: Updated expiresAt and one-hour HttpOnly cookie

401.description: Missing, revoked or expired session

403.description: Wrong portal origin

post.description: Admin password login only. Developers authenticate through the verified Emisell merchant session. Sets HttpOnly host-only emisell_portal_session; HTTPS uses Secure. Exact dashboard origin required.

200.description: Authenticated user with server-selected surface and role

401.description: Invalid admin credentials; developer password login is not supported

403.description: Wrong origin

get.description: Read unified cookie session. Requires exact dashboard Origin/Referer; returns user with backend-selected surface. Does not accept client role or organization overrides.

401.description: Missing or expired session

403.description: Wrong origin

get.description: Administrator-only read directory of admin portal accounts. Requires admin session and exact Admin Origin/Referer. Returns at most 50 accounts ordered by ID; pass nextAfterId as afterId. Enabled is login eligibility, not online presence. No passwords, sessions, invitations, role changes or developer accounts are exposed.

401.description: Missing or expired session

403.description: Wrong origin or not administrator

get.description: Administrator-only read directory. Requires admin session cookie and exact Admin Origin/Referer. Returns at most 50 organizations ordered by ID; use nextAfterId as afterId. No account emails, credentials, or membership writes.

401.description: Missing or expired admin session

403.description: Wrong origin or not administrator

get.description: Administrator-only organization detail. Requires admin session cookie and exact Admin Origin/Referer. Read-only; no email or credentials returned.

401.description: Missing or expired admin session

403.description: Wrong origin or not administrator

post.description: Credentials provisioned explicitly by CLI; no implicit upgrade of merchant accounts. Replaces this surface's previous session. ADR 0022: authoring/distribusi baru hanya shipping/v1. Payment gateway checkout internal Emisell, bukan aplikasi umum. Record payment historis tetap terbaca; reject/suspend/revoke tersedia. Pengajuan/approval/sign/publish dan kesiapan app-client/Testing payment ditolak. Instalasi/RPC payment fixture tidak diubah.

endpoint.description: Empty allowed in draft; nonempty must be HTTPS without userinfo or fragment. Never fetched in this milestone.

activeVersion.description: Active developer configuration snapshot. Created atomically with a new app, independent of review, runtime releases and merchant grants. Editing a draft does not replace this snapshot.

revision.description: 0 on create; exact current revision on update.

PrivateProductDocument.description: Private headless product reader. Initial signed configuration and stable app credential are created atomically. No marketplace review, store assignment, consent or grant is created. Requires configured private-product signing/runtime composition. Updates do not replace the immutable active version.

endpoint.description: Empty allowed in draft; nonempty must be HTTPS without userinfo or fragment. Never fetched in this milestone.

PublicAppDocument.description: Input authoring aplikasi umum. Identitas draft payment lama tidak boleh diubah menjadi shipping.

UnifiedPortalSession.name: emisell_portal_session
UnifiedPortalSession.description: Shared dashboard cookie at /api/v1. HttpOnly, SameSite Strict, Secure for HTTPS. Server-side session remains bound to one authenticated surface; does not grant both roles.

AdminSession.name: emisell_admin_session
AdminSession.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/v1/admin, 8h. Local HTTP only; production requires Secure/HTTPS.
